cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'PYEOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")
# Delete all PM2 processes
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 delete all")
print("Deleted PM2 processes")
# Fix both package.json files
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '/\"type\": \"module\"/d' /root/opt/areloria/package.json")
print("Fixed root package.json")
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("sed -i '/\"type\": \"module\"/d' /root/opt/areloria/server/package.json")
print("Fixed server package.json")
# Start fresh
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 start /root/opt/areloria/ecosystem.config.cjs && sleep 5 && pm2 list")
print("\n=== PM2 Status ===")
print(stdout.read().decode())
client.close()
PYEOF
